nvitk.core
==========

.. py:module:: nvitk.core

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Public core API: NumPy/CuPy backend switching, array helpers, and proxy setup.

   Typical GPU-aware code::

       from nvitk.core import setup, get_current_backend
       setup(globals())

       def f(x):
           return np.asarray(x)  # np follows active backend after setup

.. py:function:: as_backend_array(arr: Any, backend: str | None = None, copy: bool = False, strict: bool = False) -> Any

   Convert *arr* to NumPy or CuPy using :func:`~nvitk.core.backend.get_current_backend` when *backend* is None.

   :param arr: Any array-like or CuPy/NumPy array.
   :param backend: ``numpy``/``cpu``/``np`` or ``cupy``/``gpu``/``cp``; default follows current context.
   :param copy: Force a copy on conversion.
   :param strict: For CuPy: raise :class:`~nvitk.core.exceptions.BackendUnavailableError` if CuPy missing.

   :raises ValueError: Unknown *backend* string.


.. py:function:: ensure_same_backend(*arrays: Any, backend: str | None = None) -> tuple[Any, Ellipsis]

   Apply :func:`as_backend_array` to each input with the same *backend* (or current).


.. py:function:: is_cupy_array(arr: Any) -> bool

   True if *arr* is a ``cupy.ndarray``.


.. py:function:: is_numpy_array(arr: Any) -> bool

   True if *arr* is a ``numpy.ndarray``.


.. py:function:: to_cupy(arr: Any, copy: bool = False, strict: bool = False)

   Move *arr* to CuPy, or return NumPy array if *strict* is False and CuPy is unavailable.

   :param strict: If True, raise :class:`~nvitk.core.exceptions.BackendUnavailableError` when CuPy cannot load.


.. py:function:: to_numpy(arr: Any, copy: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray

   Materialize *arr* on CPU as ``numpy.ndarray`` (``get()`` for CuPy).


.. py:class:: BackendModules

   Triple of ``(xp, scipy, ndi)`` for the resolved backend name.


   .. py:attribute:: xp
      :type:  Any


   .. py:attribute:: scipy
      :type:  Any


   .. py:attribute:: ndi
      :type:  Any


.. py:function:: available_backends() -> tuple[BackendName, Ellipsis]

   Tuple of backend names usable on this machine (always includes ``numpy``).


.. py:function:: get_array_module(array: Any) -> Any

   Return ``cupy`` or ``numpy`` depending on *array*'s type.


.. py:function:: get_backend_modules(name: str | None = None, allow_fallback: bool = True) -> BackendModules

   Return :class:`BackendModules` for *name* or :func:`get_current_backend`.

   :param name: Optional explicit backend; default is current context.
   :param allow_fallback: Passed to :func:`_resolve_backend` when *name* is given.


.. py:function:: get_current_backend() -> BackendName

   Active backend for this context (thread/async aware via :class:`contextvars.ContextVar`).


.. py:function:: get_global_backend() -> BackendName

   Process-wide default backend (updated by :func:`set_global_backend`).


.. py:function:: get_ops(name: str | None = None, allow_fallback: bool = True) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]

   Return ``(xp, scipy, ndi)`` tuple for *name* or current backend.


.. py:function:: is_cupy_installed() -> bool

   True if the ``cupy`` package imported (does not guarantee a usable GPU).


.. py:function:: is_gpu_available() -> bool

   True if CuPy is installed and a CUDA device is visible.


.. py:function:: register_module_for_backend_updates(module_name: str, module_globals: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None

   Register *module_name* so backend switches refresh its ``np``/``scipy``/``ndi`` globals.

   Typically used together with :func:`setup_backend_proxy` via :func:`setup`.


.. py:function:: set_default_backend(name: str, allow_fallback: bool = True) -> BackendName

   Alias for :func:`set_global_backend` (default ``allow_fallback=True`` for CLI use).


.. py:function:: set_global_backend(name: str, allow_fallback: bool = False) -> BackendName

   Set the default backend for new code and refresh registered module proxies.

   :param name: ``numpy`` or ``cupy`` (aliases accepted).
   :param allow_fallback: If True and CuPy is unavailable, use NumPy instead of raising.

   :returns: The resolved backend actually in effect.
   :rtype: BackendName


.. py:function:: setup(module_globals: dict[str, Any], module_name: str | None = None)

   One-call setup: :func:`~nvitk.core.proxy.setup_backend_proxy` + :func:`register_module_for_backend_updates`.

   :param module_globals: Pass ``globals()`` from the calling module.
   :param module_name: Defaults to ``module_globals['__name__']``.

   :returns: The proxy bound to *module_globals*.
   :rtype: BackendProxy


.. py:function:: synchronize() -> None

   If current backend is CuPy, synchronize the default CUDA stream (no-op otherwise).


.. py:class:: using(backend_name: str, allow_fallback: bool = True)

   Context manager for scoped backend switching (updates :class:`contextvars.ContextVar`).

   .. rubric:: Examples

   .. code-block:: python

       with using("cupy"):
           x = np.array([1])  # CuPy array module


   .. py:attribute:: backend_name


   .. py:attribute:: allow_fallback
      :value: True



   .. py:attribute:: _token
      :type:  object | None
      :value: None



   .. py:method:: __enter__() -> using

      Switch the context-local backend and refresh proxied module globals.



   .. py:method:: __exit__(exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb) -> None

      Restore the previous backend on block exit.



   .. py:method:: __repr__() -> str

      Developer-friendly representation echoing the requested backend.



.. py:function:: using_backend(name: str, allow_fallback: bool = True) -> Iterator[BackendName]

   Context manager: temporarily set :func:`get_current_backend` to *name* (generator style).

   Prefer :class:`using` for the attribute-style API; this is the lower-level API.


.. py:class:: BackendProxy(module_name: str)

   Lazily bind ``np``, ``scipy``, ``ndi`` in a module's ``globals()`` to the active backend.

   On :meth:`refresh_globals`, inserts either NumPy/SciPy or CuPy/cupyx equivalents.
   Unknown attribute access forwards to the active array module (``proxy.np``).


   .. py:attribute:: module_name


   .. py:attribute:: _cached_backend
      :type:  str | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: _cached_modules
      :type:  tuple[Any, Any, Any] | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: _module_globals
      :type:  dict[str, Any] | None
      :value: None



   .. py:method:: _resolve_modules() -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]

      Return the ``(array, scipy, ndimage)`` triple for the active backend, cached per backend.



   .. py:method:: bind_globals(module_globals: dict[str, Any]) -> None

      Store *module_globals* and populate ``np``/``scipy``/``ndi`` keys.



   .. py:method:: invalidate() -> None

      Drop cached backend tuple so the next access re-reads :func:`~nvitk.core.backend.get_current_backend`.



   .. py:method:: refresh_globals() -> None

      Write current ``(np, scipy, ndi)`` triple into bound module globals.



   .. py:property:: np
      :type: Any


      Active array module — NumPy on the CPU backend, CuPy on the GPU backend.


   .. py:property:: scipy
      :type: Any


      Active SciPy module — ``scipy`` or ``cupyx.scipy``.


   .. py:property:: ndi
      :type: Any


      Active n-d image module — ``scipy.ndimage`` or ``cupyx.scipy.ndimage``.


   .. py:method:: __getattr__(name: str) -> Any

      Forward any unknown attribute to the active array module (so ``proxy.zeros`` works).



.. py:function:: get_backend_proxy(module_name: str | None = None) -> BackendProxy

   Return (or create) the :class:`BackendProxy` keyed by *module_name*.

   If *module_name* is omitted, uses the caller's ``__name__`` via the stack.


.. py:function:: setup_backend_proxy(module_globals: dict[str, Any], module_name: str | None = None) -> BackendProxy

   Bind *module_globals* to a proxy for this package (typically ``setup_backend_proxy(globals())``).

   :returns: The proxy instance; call :meth:`BackendProxy.refresh_globals` after backend changes (normally automatic).
   :rtype: BackendProxy
